---
title: "Research"
description: "Research themes: modelling, estimation, control, perception and sensing for marine robots."
---

Our themes follow the chain from physics to behavior: model the vehicle, estimate its state, control it, and sense the water around it.

## Dynamic modelling and control {#modelling-control}

Nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom models of our vehicles, built on standard marine-craft formulations, and controllers designed from them. Marjan-R1 has a derived model and open-loop pool validation. Closed-loop control is the next step.

*Platforms:* [Marjan-R1](platforms/marjan-r1.qmd)

## State estimation and system identification {#state-estimation}

Fusing inertial, pressure and sonar data, and fitting model parameters from experiments. Marjan-R1 is instrumented for system identification.

<span class="tc">[TO CONFIRM: current status of this work.]</span>

## Energy-aware autonomy {#energy-aware-autonomy}

Deciding when to act, not only how, to extend battery life. Our event-triggered glider control reduces energy use in simulation.

*Platforms:* [Underwater glider](platforms/glider.qmd)

## Simulation and digital twins {#simulation-digital-twins}

Simulation as a way to test controllers safely before hardware trials.

*Platforms:* [Simulation and digital-twin environments](platforms/simulation.qmd)

<span class="tc">[TO CONFIRM: scope.]</span>

## Underwater perception {#underwater-perception}

Camera-based pose estimation and visual sensing for underwater robots. In development.

*Platforms:* [Three-camera pose-estimation system](platforms/pose-estimation.qmd)

## Hyperspectral sensing {#hyperspectral-sensing}

Spectral imaging as a route to characterizing water and surfaces. Benchtop stage only.

*Platforms:* [Hyperspectral imaging rig](platforms/hyperspectral.qmd)

## Bioinspired locomotion {#bioinspired-locomotion}

Fish-like propulsion and learned control.

*Platforms:* [Fish-like robots](platforms/fish-robots.qmd)
